name: What is the typical process for cabinet repair with Frasheski Construction?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical process for cabinet repair with Frasheski Construction?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our cabinet repair process typically begins with an initial consultation to assess the damage and discuss your specific needs. Following this, we provide a detailed estimate outlining the scope of work and expected costs. Upon approval, we schedule the repair work, which may involve on-site adjustments, material sourcing, or custom fabrication depending on the damage. We aim to keep you informed throughout, ensuring the repair seamlessly integrates with your home's existing aesthetic and minimizing disruption to your daily routine.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process involves an initial assessment, detailed estimate, and scheduled repair work, keeping you informed from start to finish.
